item.title: Jacob Bridgeman holds on at Riviera for first PGA Tour title
item.description: LOS ANGELES — Jacob Bridgeman allowed himself to imagine winning the Genesis Invitational, the massive crowd filling the amphitheater around the 18th green at Riviera, the trophy presentation with Tiger Woods. Almost all of it came true Sunday except for one small detail.

item.title: Roundup: Eileen Gu’s halfpipe victory among highlights final day of Olympics
item.description: MILAN — Eileen Gu is now 6-for-6 in Olympic medal events after another halfpipe victory.

item.title: Hellebuyck, Hughes add names to U.S. Olympic hockey legends
item.description: MILAN — Go ahead and put the names Jack Hughes and Connor Hellebuyck in the same revered place that Mike Eruzione and Jim Craig have occupied since their “Miracle On Ice ” triumph in 1980.

item.title: Overtime hockey heartbreak closes Milan Cortina Olympics for Canada
item.description: MILAN — Canada’s Olympic run in Italy ended with a 2-1 overtime loss to the United States in the men’s hockey final Sunday.

item.title: Slugger Kurtz looks to build on AL Rookie of the Year Award
item.description: MESA, Ariz. — Aside from towering over most of his Athletics teammates at 6-foot-5, Nick Kurtz blends in at his locker in the middle of the clubhouse. And that’s just the way he prefers it.
